title: GAR Title 10, Chapter 5. Agana Boat Basin - (Department of Parks & Recreation)
text:
10 GAR - HARBORS AND NAVIGATION
CHAPTER 5
Agana Boat Basin
(Department of Parks and Recreation)
NOTE: Rule-making authority cited for formulation of regulations
for the Agana Boat Basin by the Director of Parks and Recreation,
21 GCA §77104.
The regulations for the Agana Boat Basin can be found in
Title 16 Natural Resources and Recreation, Division VI Parks and
Recreation Division (Department of Parks and Recreation),
Chapter 2, Guam Administrative Rules.
§5100. Rules and Regulations Incorporated
Herein by Reference. The rules and regulations for
Agana Boat Basin are incorporated herein by
reference.
CH. 5 - AGANA BOAT BASIN - 1997 - P. 1
